alt: A flow shows the original instructions naming GetCompanyValue, which does not exist in OpenTTD 13.4, so the script dies and scores 0 on 5 of 5 seeds, while the fixed version names GetQuarterlyCompanyValue, which exists.
caption: The task told solvers to call a game function that does not exist, so the starter crashed on its first statement; the fix changes the instructions and starter.
